title: Colossal cave
tagline: The original adventure. Bring a lamp.
teaser: Explore a vast cave by typing what you want to do, gather its treasures and solve its puzzles. The original adventure, reborn.

manPage.synopsis: adventure — type short commands to explore the cave and collect its treasures.
manPage.description: Will Crowther and Don Woods wrote the original in Fortran; Jim Gillogly translated it to C, and that version came to BSD.

howToPlay: Type short commands like "go north" or "get lamp".
Explore the cave and gather its treasures.
Solve its puzzles and find your way back out.
